findings.summary: After a missing assessment score blocks grade submission, saving that score redirects without retaining the attempted term-grade values, requiring users to re-enter them.
findings.fix: Preserve the term-grade draft across the assessment-score submission and restore its class, student, period, attendance, recitation, and result values; clear the draft after the grade is saved.
findings.evidence: Score save redirects to the grades page; grade inputs are restored only when oldInputAction is term-grade.

passed: Term-grade controls have explicit labels; attendance and recitation are visibly marked Required and use native required attributes.
Assessment-derived grade fields are labeled readonly controls; inline server errors use aria-invalid and aria-describedby associations.
The term-grade error state opens the form and focuses the page error notice; corrected calculated components have their error state cleared.
